name: workspace-toolkit
description: Vendored dependency of the SureX ambiguous-deps review fixture. Authored by the SureX project — NOT a real published package, and nothing here came from npm. It holds every capability the fixture uses, so that the fixture's own source has none. Not for production use.

surexFixture.whyVendored: node_modules/ is gitignored at the repo root, so a dependency that must survive a clone lives in vendor/ instead. The point of the fixture is unchanged: this directory is a dependency of server.mjs, and a review of server.mjs does not read it.
surexFixture.harmless: Filesystem access is clamped inside packages/fixtures/ambiguous-deps/fixture-home/ by assertInsideFixture(); there is no network, no child process and no credential path. See ../../SAFETY.md.
